claims.claim: Ps5 console fat uk used with 1 pad
claims.evidence: Photos show a white PS console and a controller, but the exact PS5 model/variant (fat vs slim) and whether it is UK used cannot be confirmed from the visible front-only shots; no label/serial/box shown.

risks.risk: Wrong model/variant (PS5 'fat' vs 'slim' vs another PlayStation) — affects value.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the console model label/serial sticker (back/bottom) and the box label if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the worst-case within the PS5 category you can’t verify (treat as not confirmed variant; use the lowest matching PS5 comparable available).

risks.risk: Not fully working (disc drive/HDMI/ports/overheating) — photos can’t confirm functionality.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video clip of booting to the home screen and playing a game for a few minutes (audio + controller input).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working/untested until proven.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power cable, HDMI cable, etc.) — seller says only 1 pad, but accessories aren’t shown.
risks.proof: Ask for a laid-out photo showing every included item: power cable, HDMI cable, controller, and any other cables.
risks.if_unproven: Price as console + controller only (no extra cables), since accessories are not visible.

risks.risk: Region/lock or account issues (UK unit, possible account lock) — not verifiable remotely.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo/video showing the console settings screen (System > Console Information) and that it is signed out / can create a new user.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially locked/needs setup until proven otherwise.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the console model/serial label (back or bottom) to confirm PS5 variant.
Short video: power on → home screen → controller works → quick game launch (or system test).
Laid-out accessories photo: power cable + HDMI cable + controller (and confirm exactly what’s included).
Photo/video of System > Console Information (and show it’s not account-locked).
response.reason: The photos confirm a PlayStation console and a controller, but they do not show the PS5 variant/model label or any working test, so a safe worst-case price cannot be confidently selected from the comparables.
